model.name: R20.30: Traceability Chain ≠ All Children — they must show DIFFERENT content.
model.description: The detail view Traceability Chain and All Children sections DIFFER by BREADTH vs DEPTH: (1) ALL CHILDREN = ALL child nodes of the node — e.g. a CLASS shows ALL its child methods (RbDetailDrawer has 14 methods, MATCHING the class badge count "14"). This is BREADTH — every child, flat. (2) TRACEABILITY CHAIN = the forward CHAIN path to the CURRENT method's IMPLEMENTATION — the active-chain hop: class → current method → impl → test → gate. NOT all children — only the singular path through the chain-relevant method to its impl. This is DEPTH — one path, deep. AC: open a Class detail in a chain context → All Children lists all 14 methods (= badge count); Traceability Chain shows only the path through the CURRENT method to its impl/test/gate. They MUST differ (currently identical — both show the same content).
model.tronQuote:
> TRON (IMG_4060): "Traceability Chain ≠ All Children — they must show DIFFERENT content."
> TRON (precise spec): All Children = ALL child nodes (breadth, e.g. 14 methods = badge). Traceability Chain = forward chain to current method's impl (depth, one path).
model.crossRefNote: R20.5 (universal chain-vs-children) defined this rule. R20.30 re-asserts it as a bug — implementation still renders both sections identically.

intendedChain.useCase: detailView.distinctSections — Traceability Chain shows only forward-chain nodes; All Children shows all child nodes; content differs
intendedChain.method: renderTraceabilitySection (chain-walk filtered) vs renderAllChildrenSection (union of arrays) — must use DIFFERENT data sources
intendedChain.test: RED: open Class RbDetailDrawer (14 methods) in chain context → All Children lists 14 methods (= badge count). Traceability Chain shows only 1 method path (current→impl→test→gate). They differ. Currently FAILS (both show identical content).

architectDesign.diagnosis: detail-superseded.ts:renderAllChildrenSection receives children[] from fetchDetailData (detail-children.ts) which calls /api/trace/children?mode=scenario — this returns ALL forward children per scenarioFwd keys. rb-detail-view.ts:115 renders this as "All Children". BUT there is NO separate "Traceability Chain" section. The detail view has ONLY All Children + Superseded. R20.30 demands a SECOND section showing the chain-walk (depth) vs the existing All Children (breadth).
architectDesign.rootCause: renderAllChildrenSection is the ONLY children renderer. No renderTraceabilityChainSection exists. Both "Traceability Chain" and "All Children" render the same data because there is only one section. The fix requires adding a NEW section.

fix.step1_new_function: Add renderTraceabilityChainSection(container, uuid, chainContext) to detail-superseded.ts. This function: (a) takes the current chain context (which UC/Method/Impl is the active-chain path), (b) fetches /api/trace/children?mode=trace for the node, (c) if the node is a Class, filters methods to ONLY the chain-relevant method (the one in the UC.method field of the navigated-from UC), (d) renders the filtered chain path as a separate section ABOVE All Children.
fix.step2_chain_context_threading: The chain context (which UC led to this Class, which Method is chain-relevant) must be threaded through navigation. When user taps UC→Class in the tree, the UC.method UUID is the chain-relevant method. Store this as a data attribute on the detail view: data-chain-method="<uuid>". renderTraceabilityChainSection reads it to filter.
fix.step3_visual_distinction: Traceability Chain section: header "Traceability Chain" with chain icon (🔗), shows ONLY the singular forward path (1 method, 1 impl, 1 test, 1 gate). All Children section: header "All Children" with count badge (14), shows ALL children flat. Both sections render independently — different data, different count, different heading.
fix.step4_wire_in_rb_detail_view: In rb-detail-view.ts after line 115 (renderAllChildrenSection): add renderTraceabilityChainSection(this, obj.uuid, chainContext). The chainContext comes from the navigation state (SelectionModel or URL params).

files: nav.ts or SelectionModel (thread chain context through navigation)
architectDesign.gate: Open Class RbDetailDrawer (14 methods) in chain context. All Children shows 14 methods (=badge). Traceability Chain shows 1 method→impl→test→gate. Sections DIFFER. DET-3x.
